# D - Transformations

## When to Use
- Building Silver or Gold layer logic
- Calculating financial indicators or aggregations
- Reviewing granularity or join logic

## Procedure
1. Understand the raw data and business rule behind the metric.
2. Define granularity and aggregation strategy.
3. Implement or review transformation logic.
4. Validate resulting indicators and document assumptions.

## Standards
- Keep metric names and semantics consistent across layers.
- Document mathematical assumptions and limitations.
